subject: Post-call recap: economic buyer map + PO/timeline confirmation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@gridpay.com>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@gridpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: economic buyer map + PO/timeline confirmation

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Decision roles (as we understood them)
  - Economic buyer: Elena Soto (Head of Platform) — primary for pricing/commitment
  - Procurement & PO: Tom Hargreaves / procurement@gridpay.com — handles PO/contract intake
  - Legal & Security: likely routed to GridPay Legal (Elena to confirm contact)
  - Technical champion: internal ML infra lead (you mentioned Jamie) for rollout sign-off

2) Key decision criteria you flagged
  - Predictable unit cost and per-token economics at scale
  - Private deployment options + KMS integration for PII workloads
  - Audit logs and retention controls for compliance

3) Vendor onboarding items we will share
  - Redwood vendor onboarding checklist (PDF) — includes SOC2 artifacts and KYC items
  - Vendor security questionnaire (spreadsheet) — please indicate any additional evidence required
  - PO template (Word) — to speed procurement acceptance

4) Suggested timeline / milestones
  - 9/10: We send onboarding docs + draft SOW and PO template (Ben)
  - 9/14: Legal / security review kickoff (GridPay)
  - 9/21: Procurement issues PO or requests redlines; target to start dedicated capacity provisioning by early Oct

Immediate asks for you:
  - Elena: confirm the legal/security contact and whether SOC2 Type II evidence suffices or you need an encrypted HSM attestation.
  - Tom: confirm the PO recipient email and whether GridPay requires invoice to reference a PO number upfront.

I attached the onboarding checklist, the PO template and the vendor questionnaire to this thread for convenience.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive 
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138

Attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.pdf (summary), GridPay_PO-template.docx (editable), Vendor-Security-Q-2026.xlsx
From: Elena Soto <esoto@gridpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@gridpay.com>
Cc: procurement@gridpay.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: economic buyer map + PO/timeline confirmation

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Legal/Security: Please loop in Maria Gomez (maria.gomez@gridpay.com) — she'll run the questionnaire and validate SOC2 artifacts.
- Procurement: Yes, PO should be sent to procurement@gridpay.com and invoices must include the PO number; procurement will raise PO after legal signs off.
- HSM attestation is not required for initial pilot; SOC2 Type II plus a short pen-test summary will be sufficient. If we scale to production with customer PII we will revisit HSM requirements.

Timeline tweak: Legal usually needs 5 business days once they have the questionnaire + artifacts. So our tentative dates look good provided you can share the docs today.

Also copying our SRE lead (Jamie Park) on the questionnaire review later this week.

Elena
Elena Soto | Head of Platform
GridPay
esoto@gridpay.com | +1 (650) 555-9810
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@gridpay.com>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@gridpay.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: economic buyer map + PO/timeline confirmation

Elena — appreciate the quick reply and the legal contact. Attaching the files again here and calling out the specific asks inside each doc: 

- Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.pdf: short checklist + where to find SOC2 report and contact for security deep-dive. Ask: confirm acceptance of SOC2 Type II and indicate any trial-specific evidence needed.
- Vendor-Security-Q-2026.xlsx: we prefixed rows with "Required for PO" and "Optional for Pilot" — Maria, please mark any additional evidence you need.
- GridPay_PO-template.docx: editable PO that includes payment wiring and invoice remittance block — Tom, if this looks good, feel free to send back a completed version.

Proposed immediate next steps:
  - Today (9/10 EOD): Ben shares docs (done)
  - 9/14: Legal review notes returned by Maria
  - 9/16: Procurement confirms PO issuance timeline (Tom)

Priyom — looping you in to optionally join the legal/security call if Maria requests an architecture walkthrough or logs access explanation.

If it's helpful, Laura (our Solutions Lead) can provide a short one-pager on how Redwood handles KV caching and audit log retention for private deployments. Laura, can you send that by tomorrow?

Thanks,
Ben

Attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.pdf, Vendor-Security-Q-2026.xlsx, GridPay_PO-template.docx

Ben —

Procurement confirms receipt of the PO template. Quick note on invoices: we require the PO number in the invoice header; our AP team prefers net-30 but we can discuss payment milestones if there's a setup fee. I'll aim to confirm whether GridPay can issue PO by 9/16 after legal greenlight.

Procurement will reach back with a completed PO form if there are no material changes.
